# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 95 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)

**Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 50 | Coptic

---

## Saying 95

Jesus said: "If you have money, do not lend it at interest. Rather, give it to one from whom you will not get it back."

---

**Council Notes:**

- Thomas goes beyond the Q prohibition on usury (Luke 6:34-35) to a more radical instruction: do not lend at all — give to those who cannot repay.
- "Lend at interest" (*toubo*): the Coptic word specifically denotes usurious lending.
- "Give it to one from whom you will not get it back" — the criterion for legitimate generosity is precisely the impossibility of repayment. This mirrors the beatitude logic: give without calculation.
- "Rather" (EMET) over "Instead" (LOGOS): the Coptic adversative particle suggests the stronger redirecting contrast.
